conclusion: Retain the shipped default. New gait candidates do not establish an overall improvement in the common band and show configured tilt stops in the full-range screen. Jump capability was not measured; replacement candidates lack its trained reference contract.
additional_independent_review_caveat: After mj_step, integrated qpos/qvel can be one 1/520s step ahead of derived xmat/geom/contact/actuator fields. These traces have up to1.923ms derived-field lag; contact-phase precision and absolute effort/slip comparisons to other evaluators require care.

validation.scope: Production native dense stack vs NumPy forward for actual shipped, Stable, Mixed and fast exports; per-policy references; history/reset/fade/pre-clamp feedback; heading isolation; range refusal; explicit no-jump requirement; full-hull physical smoke and driver limits.

limitations: No mass/friction/gain randomization, sensor noise/latency, encoder bias, external pushes or hardware tests.
Initial pose perturbations only; four replicas do not establish robustness.
Production RTNeural/reference/filter headers; explicit transcription of ROS lifecycle/history plumbing, not ROS execution.
Native CPU solver520Hz differs from training solver250Hz; inference52Hz differs from training50Hz.
Slip uses foot-site XY speed when any lower-leg geometry contacts ground, including hulls.
Stop criterion is configured Gemini tilt stop; metric is controller-stop incidents, not every possible physical failure.
No jumps or automatic controller/policy promotion.
